description: FHR3A controlled table-size suite, NLHE 100BB at 3/4/6/8 seats, one scheduled reference population (per-slot 40% neutral / 20% tight / 20% loose / 20% aggressive). Target: 1 BB/100 of candidate hands, two-sided alpha 0.05, 80% power. Medians over pairings p1-p3. Ratios ('_rel_base') are relative to the controlled 6-max corpus.
question: Does required played hands (per-hand resolving difficulty) stay flat in table size?

primary_controlled.note: The publication 3/4/6/8 curve: controlled corpora only.

historical_frozen.note: Frozen core corpora with table-size-dependent fixed populations (4-max mixed3-v1, 6-max mixed5-v1). NOT part of the primary curve. '_rel_base' is relative to historical 6-max; '*_first_n' = first 30k blocks.

controlled_vs_historical.note: Same table size, same deals (paired on block id); only the reference population differs. sigma ratio controlled / historical, paired bootstrap.
